metadata.description: YouCloned by BNSN, plus the open-source skills it ships with, each installed from its author.

plugins.name: youcloned
plugins.description: YouCloned: your AI clone inside the Claude app. Your rules, your crew, Codex checks, and SkillKey skills.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design skills by Paul Bakaus (Apache 2.0): polish, typeset, layout, colorize, audit and more. Installed from the author's own project.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI and UX design library by Next Level Builder (MIT): styles, palettes, font pairings, brand and slides. Installed from the author's own project.

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: HyperFrames by HeyGen (Apache 2.0): make and render videos from HTML. Installed from the author's own project.

plugins.name: video-shotcraft
plugins.description: Video Shotcraft by Wei Yihao (Apache 2.0): cinematic product videos from shot recipes. Hosted by BNSN after the original project went offline.

plugins.name: printing-press
plugins.description: Printing Press by Matt Van Horn and Trevin Chow (MIT): turn any API into a command-line tool and skill. Installed from the author's own project.

plugins.name: notebooklm
plugins.description: NotebookLM by Teng Lin (MIT): notebooks, sources, audio overviews and more from Claude. Installed from the author's own project.
